title: ROADMAP-1: QNFO.REACH #A2A-V1: A2A v1.0 agent card and task endpoint
body:
code-task: repo=ultrastable path=site/agentic.js
code-anchor: export const AGENT_CARD

**Owner:** product-manager
**Program:** QNFO.REACH
**Metric it should move:** readers
**Cost rule:** adds no worker, cron or paid model call (fleet_budget cap is breached; cost 426.89 vs 300).
**Done check:** merged and verified live (VERIFY-LIVE-1) with a probe the author did not write
**Status:** open

The card declares protocol 0.3.0 and streaming false; A2A reached v1.0 on 2026-03-12. Serve a v1.0 card, accept message/send and tasks/get so another agent can hand Ultrastable a task and poll it, backed by the intake path. Prediction: agent-originated intake items go from 0 to >=1/week; metric readers (agents count as readers).
